text.d10.alog.class_ii: SG-900 firewall/IDS carries the deepest Annex I scope.
text.d10.alog.psirt_capacity: Lead plus analyst on top of the two-person IC PSIRT; 24/7 on-call allowance of EUR 60k a year.
text.d10.alog.psirt_capacity_change: Works council agreement on on-call (T11); case volumes after 11 Dec 2027.
text.d10.alog.psirt_rate: Loaded rate for the PSIRT lead hire and the analyst seconded from IC (task T12).
text.d11.as05.basis: Cost model remediation drivers; R02 mitigation (defer two roadmap features; contractors).
d11.decision.BD1: Protects EUR 468m of EU revenue that needs a notified body for 0.77% of one year's revenue; scenarios EUR 7.9m to 11.4m.
d11.decision.BD2: Signing the DoC assumes responsibility for compliance (Art 28(4)); a written instrument and pre-signature checklist control it.
d11.decision.BD3: No CRA notified body verifiably designated (checks to 8 Sep 2026); capacity is the binding constraint for seven families.
d11.decision.BD4: Enterprise frameworks let owners accept risk above appetite on a business case; for product risk the CRA guidance does not, so it needs its own rule and appeal route.
d11.decision.BD5: Keeps scarce engineering and notified-body capacity (R01, R02) for the seven Class I and II families; IR-500 and IS-300 give the customers a migration path.
d11.decision.SD1: One quality-system approval covers five families with one body and builds on the IEC 62443-4-1 certified process (2024).
d11.decision.SD2: Avoids under-booking scarce notified-body capacity if either family proves Class I; remediation sequencing is unchanged.
d11.decision.SD3: Keeps notified-body proposals, PSIRT hiring and SBOM tooling moving before the board; within the Q4 2026 envelope (EUR 1.42m).
d11.decision.SD4: The system of record must hold 10 years of evidence per version and answer a reasoned request within 10 working days.
text.d11.decision_detail.SD1: Module H for IR-500, IS-300, SG-900, SecureLink and FleetView under one notified body; V1 and L2 stay on Module B+C.
text.d11.decision_detail.SD2: Both families included in notified-body capacity planning; remediation stays in Wave 2; legal opinion due 27 Nov 2026.
text.d11.decision_detail.SD3: EUR 0.75m released for mobilisation ahead of the 19 Nov 2026 board.
text.d11.decision_detail.SD4: Selection criteria approved; system-of-record decision due 18 Dec 2026 (T05).
text.d11.dp03.detail: Formal consultation opened; needed to sustain weekend filing (R08).
text.d11.dp04.detail: Budget, signing authority, notified-body strategy, product-risk rule, legacy lines.
d11.issue.I01: Refresh the per-product distribution map for the SRP 'Member States' field (T10).
d11.issue.I02: Legal opinion (T07); until then plan notified-body capacity for both families (SD2).
d11.issue.I03: Add binary SCA to HBS firmware builds (T18).
